source.name: WorldPop 2020 1 km UN-adjusted (Global_2000_2020_1km, 2020)
source.note: Same product family as the tabulated city figures (WorldPop, 2020 estimates) but the downloadable 1 km release, not the API's 100 m R2025A surface. Aggregated to 1/24 deg cells; see /methodology/.

grid.origin: x00y00 is 180 W .. 170 W, 90 N .. 80 N; y increases southward
grid.order: row-major, north to south, west to east, one byte per cell

bins.decode: level 0 = 0 people; level i>0 = floor * ratio^(i-0.5)
